response.rationale: OrderLine (A) and Order (B) are distinct business concepts in a part-whole relationship. In PlaceOrderUseCase (node 6860bbf1a3b5131d, src/ordering/application/place-order.use-case.ts), the method signature `execute(id: string, customerEmail: string, lines: readonly OrderLine[]): Order {` shows that multiple `OrderLine` items (`lines: readonly OrderLine[]`) are passed as input to construct and return an `Order`. In OrderNotificationService (node ee110f001f97012a, src/notifications/application/order-notification.service.ts), `const subtotal = order.subtotal();` operates on the whole `Order` entity. Thus, `OrderLine` represents an individual line item within an order, whereas `Order` represents the overall order itself.
